CharacterStyleRange.Content: Spectrum rental relates to the supply of a dedicated horse racing channel and related content for the VTRI on free-to-air television and Foxtel. Racing Victoria entered a contract with an effective date of 1 July 2025 covering a three-year term.

Channel support service coverage of a fully operational production facility that enables the distribution of Victorian, South Australian, West Australian and other international jurisdiction racing across the broadcast channel. Racing Victoria entered a contract with an effective date of 1 July 2025 covering a two-year term.
